name: 自燃·炼狱之躯
description: 志志雄真実单次受到的伤害最多为1点。
skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece || !context.piece || context.piece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (context.damage <= 1) return { success: false, message: '' }; context.damage = 1; return { success: true, message: piece.name + ' 炼狱之躯：伤害被压制为1点' };
